name: Cubix AI Article Generator
author: Aasim Ghaffar

sections.description:
Stop paying $20–$50/month for standalone AI writers.

Cubix AI Article Generator turns your WordPress dashboard into an enterprise-grade AI content studio. Connect free API keys from top-tier providers like Groq, Google Gemini, OpenRouter, or Mistral (which require no credit card and take 2 minutes to set up) and generate complete blog posts, SEO metadata, outlines, FAQs, and rewrites right inside your editor.

🎬 See Cubix AI in Action

✨ Why Choose Cubix AI?

  • Zero Subscription Fees: Use your own API keys. Take advantage of generous free tiers or pay fractions of a cent per article.
  • Direct Server-to-API Architecture: No middleman servers, no data selling, no tracking. Your content stays private.
  • 12-in-1 Editor Workspace: Generate, rewrite, translate, and optimize without ever switching browser tabs.
  • 7 Supported AI Engines: Mix and match ultra-fast open-source models with flagship proprietary engines.
  • Built-in AI Chat Studio: A dedicated ChatGPT-like workspace right inside wp-admin.

✍️ 12 Powerful Writing Tasks Built Right Into Your Editor

Our sleek editor sidebar gives your editorial team supercharged workflows:

  • Write: Full articles, catchy post titles, engaging excerpts, structured outlines, and ready-to-publish FAQ sections.
  • Refine: Rewrite & improve prose, expand drafts, summarize long texts, or translate into multiple languages with full post context.
  • Optimize: AI SEO keyword ideas, relevant taxonomy tags, and conversion-focused Call-to-Action (CTA) paragraphs.

One-Click “Use It” Integration: Every result includes word counts and instant insertion directly into Gutenberg Block Editor or Classic Editor fields (Title, Content, Excerpt, SEO).

💬 AI Studio — Your In-Dashboard ChatGPT Alternative

Need a brainstorming companion or custom assistant? AI Studio gives you a complete chat interface inside WordPress:

  • Unlimited Workspaces: Start new conversations auto-titled by topic.
  • Instant Engine Switching: Swap between Gemini, Groq, Claude, or GPT mid-chat to get the best answer.
  • Privacy by Design: Chat history is private to each WordPress user and auto-purged after 10 days.

🔌 7 Supported AI Providers (Including 100% Free Tiers)

  1. Groq: Lightning-fast inference running Llama 3, Qwen, and open models. Generous free tier, no credit card required.
  2. Google Gemini: Free API keys via Google AI Studio with high daily quotas.
  3. OpenRouter: Access hundreds of AI models. Includes an “Auto — free models” selector that automatically finds currently free models.
  4. Mistral AI: High-quality European open-weight models with a free experimental tier.
  5. OpenAI: Industry-standard GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini performance.
  6. Anthropic Claude: Exceptional long-form writing and natural cadence with Claude 3.5 Sonnet.
  7. DeepSeek: Ultra-affordable, cutting-edge reasoning and content generation.

🎛️ Enterprise Team Controls & Security

  • Role-Based Access: Limit AI usage to specific roles (e.g., Administrators or Editors only).
  • Custom Prompt Library: Override default prompts and ship your team’s custom brand guidelines to all writers.
  • Encrypted Keys: API keys are encrypted at rest using your site’s unique authentication salts (AUTH_KEY / SECURE_AUTH_KEY).
  • Settings Portability: Export and import plugin settings via JSON without risking API key leaks.

External Services

This plugin connects directly to third-party AI provider APIs to process content generation, key validation, and AI Studio chats. No data is transmitted until an authenticated user explicitly clicks Generate, Test connection, or submits a chat message.

All requests are made directly from your server to the provider:

  • Groq (https://api.groq.com) — Terms | Privacy Policy
  • Google Gemini (https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com) — Terms | Privacy Policy
  • OpenRouter (https://openrouter.ai) — Terms | Privacy Policy
  • Mistral AI (https://api.mistral.ai) — Terms | Privacy Policy
  • OpenAI (https://api.openai.com) — Terms | Privacy Policy
  • Anthropic Claude (https://api.anthropic.com) — Terms | Privacy Policy
  • DeepSeek (https://api.deepseek.com) — Terms | Privacy Policy

No user data or site visitor traffic is ever collected, tracked, or routed through third-party proxy servers.
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins → Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Search for Cubix AI Article Generator and click Install Now, then Activate.
  3. Navigate to Cubix AI → Settings → AI Engines.
  4. Click Get a key next to Groq or Google Gemini (both offer 100% free options).
  5. Paste your API key, click Test Connection, and save changes.
  6. Open any Post or Page editor to start writing with AI!
sections.faq:
Is this plugin really free to use?

Yes! The plugin itself is 100% free, and providers like Groq, Google Gemini, OpenRouter, and Mistral offer completely free API keys without requiring a credit card.

How does this compare to paid AI writing plugins?

Most AI plugins charge a monthly SaaS markup on top of AI costs. Cubix AI connects your WordPress site directly to the AI providers. You get full access to the best models without monthly subscription fees or word caps.

Are my API keys safe?

Yes. API keys are encrypted in your database using AES-256 encryption tied to your site’s unique secret salts. They are never exposed in site code, settings exports, or frontend assets.

Does this work with Gutenberg and the Classic Editor?

Yes! Cubix AI supports both the Block Editor (Gutenberg) and the Classic Editor (TinyMCE), including custom post types like Products, Portfolios, or News.

Is my content used to train AI models?

That depends on the provider API you choose. Major providers generally do not use paid/API data to train models, but you should review the privacy policies linked in the External Services section for full details.
